description-en: Split the hero into a 7:5 or 3:2 ratio instead of centering everything. Headline left, a subtle dot-grid or gradient bleed right. Never center the hero at Variance ≥ 4. No bouncing scroll arrows, no 'Scroll to explore' filler.
description-zh: 英雄区用 7:5 或 3:2 不对称切分，标题左置，右侧点缀淡网点或渐变色渗。Variance ≥ 4 时禁止居中。禁止弹跳滚动箭头、禁止'下滑探索'填充文字。

name-en: Card Grid — No Three Equal Columns
name-zh: 卡片网格 — 禁止三等宽
description-en: The generic 3-equal-card feature row is an AI cliché and is banned. Use a 12-column grid with 5+7, 4+8, or 8+4 Z-pattern spans. Cards get a 1px hairline border and no shadow by default; hover adds a 1px lift and darkens the border.
description-zh: 三等宽卡片行是 AI 陈词滥调，禁止。用 12 列网格，5+7、4+8 或 8+4 的 Z 形跨度。卡片默认仅 1px 发丝线边框，不放阴影；悬停时抬 1px 并加深边框色。

description-en: Cards should use a 1px hairline border (rgba(20,58,92,0.10)) and no shadow by default. Hover: translateY(-1px) + border darkens to the accent's 300 tint. Shadow only appears as a hover subtraction — never additive. Never use heavy box-shadow as the default card treatment.
description-zh: 卡片默认 1px 发丝线边框 rgba(20,58,92,0.10)，不放阴影。悬停：translateY(-1px) + 边框加深至主色 300 级。阴影仅作为悬停减法效果——从不叠加。禁止默认粗阴影卡片。

description-en: A hairline-bordered input with a 3px accent focus ring (box-shadow, not outline). Placeholder in tertiary ink. Rounded corners at 10px. Label above in uppercase 0.7rem tracking 0.12em. Never use floating labels.
description-zh: 发丝线边框输入框，聚焦时 3px 主色环（用 box-shadow 而非 outline）。placeholder 用三级墨色。10px 圆角。标签在上方，大写 0.7rem，字距 0.12em。禁止浮动标签。

description-en: Build a fluid type scale using CSS clamp(). Display: clamp(2.25rem, 5.2vw, 3.75rem), heading: clamp(2rem, 3.6vw, 2.75rem), body: 1rem. Line-height 1.65 for body, 1.15 for headings. Max 65 characters per line. Never use pure px-only font-size without a clamp fallback for responsive.
description-zh: 用 CSS clamp() 做流体字体阶梯：Display clamp(2.25rem,5.2vw,3.75rem)、Heading clamp(2rem,3.6vw,2.75rem)、正文 1rem。正文行高 1.65，标题 1.15。每行最长 65 字符。禁止只用 px 定字号无 clamp 适配。

description-en: Use exactly one brand accent color. Saturation below 80%. Derive a light tint for backgrounds and a deep shade for text/active states. The accent appears only on: CTAs, focus rings, active nav states, and link underlines. Never add a second accent. Gold/orange/yellow are reserved for identity marks, not functional UI.
description-zh: 只用一个品牌主色，饱和度低于 80%。派生浅色背景和深色文字/激活态。主色仅用于：CTA 按钮、焦点环、导航激活态、链接下划线。禁止加第二个主色。金/橙/黄保留给身份标记，不能做功能色。

description-en: Cards and list items should reveal with a cascading stagger: 0.05s, 0.13s, 0.21s, 0.29s, 0.37s. Use a spring-out cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1) and animate only transform + opacity. Duration ~0.45s. Never animate width, height, top, or left.
description-zh: 卡片和列表项用级联错落入场：0.05s, 0.13s, 0.21s, 0.29s, 0.37s。用弹性出 cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1)，仅动画 transform + opacity，时长约 0.45s。禁止动画 width/height/top/left。

description-en: A white surface header with a 1px bottom border. Logo left, nav links center or right. Mobile: stack to single column, logo centered. Active nav link underlined with the accent. No sticky header unless content height justifies it. No hamburger menu on desktop. No dropdown mega-menus.
description-zh: 白色顶栏，底部 1px 边框。Logo 左侧，导航链接居中或靠右。移动端竖排堆叠，Logo 居中。当前页用主色下划线标识。桌面端禁止汉堡菜单、禁止下拉巨型菜单。仅当内容高度合理时才用粘性定位。

description-en: White surface, top hairline, centered. Row 1: copyright. Row 2: friend links in uppercase 0.75rem tracking 0.1em. No heavy dark background — the footer should feel like the end of a page, not a separate zone. A 1px gold rule at the very top of the footer adds a warm close.
description-zh: 白色面，顶发丝线，居中。第一行版权，第二行友链大写 0.75rem 字距 0.1em。不用深色厚重底——页脚应该像页面的自然结束，而非独立区域。页脚最顶加 1px 金色线做温暖收束。

description-en: A single primary CTA per viewport. Flat fill (accent dark), no shadow at rest, hairline bottom 1px for tactile depth. Hover: darken, lift 1px. Disabled: 40% opacity + not-allowed cursor. Never use neon outer glows, never put two primary buttons side by side, never use gradient fill on a button that also has a shadow.
description-zh: 每视口最多一个主 CTA。扁平实心填充（主色深色），静止时不加阴影，底部 1px 细线提供触觉深度。悬停：加深、抬 1px。禁用：40% 透明度 + not-allowed 光标。禁止霓虹外发光、禁止并排两个主按钮、禁止渐变填充同时加阴影。

description-en: A dark surface code block with macOS traffic-light dots (red/yellow/green) in the top-left. Background: deep ink-tinted dark #0F2438. Text: soft blue-tinted light #DCEBF8. Mono font, rounded corners, subtle sky border. The traffic lights are CSS ::before decorative only. Never use a light-background code block — it reads as a note, not code.
description-zh: 深色代码块，左上角 macOS 红绿灯装饰。底 #0F2438 墨蓝色，字 #DCEBF8 蓝调浅色。等宽字体，圆角，天蓝细边框。红绿灯纯 CSS ::before 装饰。禁止浅色代码块——读起来像注释。
css: pre{position:relative;background:#0F2438;color:#DCEBF8;padding:24px 20px 20px;border-radius:10px;font-family:ui-monospace,monospace;font-size:.88rem;line-height:1.65;border:1px solid rgba(115,185,230,.18);overflow-x:auto}pre::before{content:'';position:absolute;top:12px;left:16px;width:38px;height:8px;background:radial-gradient(circle 3px at 4px 4px,#ED6A5E 60%,transparent 62%)0 0/14px 8px no-repeat,radial-gradient(circle 3px at 4px 4px,#F4BF4F 60%,transparent 62%)14px 0/14px 8px no-repeat,radial-gradient(circle 3px at 4px 4px,#61C554 60%,transparent 62%)28px 0/14px 8px no-repeat}

description-en: Instead of a generic spinner, use skeleton placeholders that match the final layout dimensions. Light gray background with a shimmer animation (linear gradient sweeping left to right, 1.5s). Never use a single circular spinner as the only loading indicator for a content-heavy page.
description-zh: 不要通用转圈，用与最终布局尺寸匹配的骨架占位。浅灰底色 + 微光动画 1.5s，与最终内容形状一致。禁止内容型页面仅用一个圆形转圈作加载指示。

description-en: An empty state needs: a small illustration or icon (48-64px, accent tint), a short heading, a 1-line description, and a single primary CTA. All centered with generous whitespace. Never show an empty-state heading without a CTA.
description-zh: 空状态需要：小插图/图标 48-64px 主色着色、简短标题、一行描述、一个主 CTA。全部居中宽裕留白。禁止有空状态标题却不跟 CTA。
